title: Effect of the outer stent position on efficacy after minimally invasive transscleral glaucoma gel stent implantation

license.statement: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (article <license>); non-commercial and no-derivatives, therefore private

indication: open-angle glaucoma (primary open-angle, pseudoexfoliation and pigment dispersion glaucoma) with insufficiently controlled IOP or intolerance of topical therapy, no previous glaucoma or intraocular surgery except SLT or uncomplicated phacoemulsification; XEN 45 gel stent with subtenon mitomycin C and primary needling, with (34 eyes) or without (32 eyes) combined cataract surgery; prospective single-arm single-centre study, 66 eyes of 54 patients

groups.description: All eyes after XEN 45 implantation with MMC, solo or combined with cataract surgery (Table 1 column 'Both groups together, n = 66')

series.notes: mean ± SD; rows 'IOP baseline', 'IOP 1 week', 'IOP 2 weeks', 'IOP 1 month', 'IOP 6 months', 'IOP 12 months'; weeks converted as weeks × 7/30.4375 months; per-visit n not reported; secondary needlings were performed in most eyes during the first year and are not stated to be excluded from the means

exclusions.what: Table 1 columns C2 'Intra- and subtenon group' and C3 'Intraconjunctival group'
exclusions.reason: subgroups defined by a postoperative finding (layer of the outer stent lumen on OCT in the first postoperative month, with criteria that include fluid spaces around the stent), not by a preoperative condition or an assigned procedure variant; the whole-cohort column is extracted instead. Subgroup counts in Table 1 rows R3 to R5 and the Abstract are also internally inconsistent with the column sizes

exclusions.what: Table 1 rows R15 to R19 (IOP reduction in % from baseline)
exclusions.reason: the same table gives the absolute IOP series, which is used

exclusions.what: Table 1 rows R21 to R26 (medications) and rows R3 to R6 (patient characteristics)
exclusions.reason: medication counts are mentioned in notes only; characteristics are not IOP series

exclusions.what: Complete and qualified surgical success, needling counts and odds ratios (Results)
exclusions.reason: success proportions and counts are not admissible

exclusions.what: IOP of subgroups by combined versus solo surgery, pseudoexfoliation, pigment dispersion, eye side and sex (Results text)
exclusions.reason: baseline and 12-month values only in text, not tabulated series

notes: Tonometer: not stated in the article.

Reference: baseline IOP with the preoperative number of IOP-lowering medications (Table 1 row R21), recorded as preoperative_medicated; IOP-lowering drops were stopped after surgery and reintroduced stepwise when needed (Methods).
One stent was explanted for bleb erosion caused during a secondary needling; the article does not state whether that eye's later IOP values were removed from the means.
Some patients contributed both eyes (66 eyes of 54 patients).
Table 1 tabulates the number of medications at each visit (rows R21 to R26); not extracted.
